title: オークスの後に・天使？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze! Ha… Haaah…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff… I won!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ev'rybody! I won!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Th-that was scary!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: Did you see her eyes? She looked like some kinda maniac! What happened to our Snow Angel?!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: She's cute, so why isn't her running cute?! I did not sign up for this…

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: I think I might be over racing…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huuuuh?! Wh-what's happen'n?!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: Good job, Harp Alpha!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text: That was a great race! I know you've got more in ya. The fall races are gonna be a blast!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I thought beat'n her would change things. That's why I worked so hard…)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Was I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What makes me and her so diff'rent?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin has managed to defeat a tough opponent, but when she returns to the waiting room, there's nothing but confusion on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: Let me start by saying congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right! I won, sure as eggs are eggs!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But it sure doesn't feel like it, the way ev'ryone outside's act'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe I wasn't cool enough t'win over the crowd like I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe it'll change when I win the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho is the final race of the Triple Tiara. If Yukino Bijin is able to win it, all doubts about her skill will be washed away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I nab a killer vict'ry there, maybe the people bummed out today'll start lik'n me again.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't y'think?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How about a word for your fans watching at home? In that cute accent of yours, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bridging the gap between what she wants and what the spectators want will be no simple task. But she's trying to remain optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Can I ask a favor?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna do a race b'fore the Shuka Sho t'make sure I turn heads.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I think it'll help me hold on to this strong desire t'win…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Any idea which one I should do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Senior-year runners can also enter the Queen Stakes, which makes it a good place to test her strength and solidify her confidence before the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: It's right in the middle of summer camp, so we'll have to travel…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That's perfectly peachy t'me! I'm used to long trips!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! I'm gonna kick that race right in the heinie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we decide on the Queen Stakes as our warm-up for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "And the winner of this year's Japanese Oaks is Yukino Bijin! Regional sensation Yukino Bijin has run away with the win!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wow. You're incredible, Yuki…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I've never seen you look so fierce b'fore… You're so cool I can barely stand it…

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I gotta keep work'n hard if I wanna make my dream come true too!
